    Which are the best open-source music-player projects? This list will help you: lx-music-desktop, spotube, pear-desktop, nuclear, lx-music-mobile, koel, and feishin.

    Echo is the only open-source music player I'll use, because it beautifully handles both on-device files and streaming service in a single app.
